summary: Iteration 15 FRONTEND-ONLY pass — 3D cinematics (three.js on expo-gl) + /cinematics gallery. Mobile viewport 390x844 on the Expo web preview (SwiftShader software GL, so first-frame shader compile is ~1-9s per scene; on-device it is ~200ms). Backend pytest NOT re-run per review-request. VERIFIED: gallery renders 8 rows with all expected testIDs (cinematic-play-standard/-falcon/-major/-dragon/-angel/-demon/-conquest/-pyramid); DRAGON variant plays with title 'Il Drago scende in campo', cinematic-dragon marker, composition chips '🔥 Fanteria 3000, Cavalleria 1500, Drago 1', GL scene renders as a dark night with stars, trees and a formation of marching soldiers with spears/shields (screenshot iter15_dragon_scene.jpg — the frame captured is early enough that the dragon silhouette is not yet at HUD altitude, but the picture is definitely NOT black), skip button appears at ~1.3s, overlay auto-disappears ~7s after skip appeared; BATTLE-REPORT CONQUEST replay (battle/btl_mar_36e5dce496f64986 → battle-cinematic-conquest) plays with title 'La Piramide è nostra!' and a fully-lit stepped pyramid + vertical light pillar + red flags + dawn sky + marching survivor formation (Cavalleria 1709) — screenshot iter15_battle_conquest.jpg; SKIP TAP closes the overlay within 1s (overlay count 0 after 1.2s). GENERIC CONQUEST from gallery (cinematic-play-conquest) renders correctly (dawn scene, castle with red-tile roofs, Casa Demo + [DEMO] banner + crest + subtitle 'Neutrale 12,180 · L7', SUPERSTITI chips 'Fanteria 860, Cavalleria 240, Carro di Conquista 1' — screenshot iter15_pyramid_scene.jpg was captured for the conquest scene during a mid-run overlay overlap). testID counts: cinematic-overlay, cinematic-title, cinematic-composition, cinematic-crest, cinematic-alliance-banner ('[DEMO]'), cinematic-skip and variant markers (cinematic-dragon on the dragon run, cinematic-conquest on both conquest and pyramid+battle runs) all found. No red screens, no page errors, no console errors during any successful run. Real DEPARTURE trigger via march launch was NOT executed (see action_items: gallery + battle-report code path exercises the same CinematicProvider used by march/new.tsx line 74 — cinematic.play is called synchronously before router.replace, identical to the gallery's cinematic.play call in cinematics.tsx:44). Map regression could not be conclusively verified this run: after tapping 'Mappa' text on the settlement screen the URL stayed on /settlement (the tab-bar 'Mappa' item did not navigate — likely a testing artefact because the settlement screen also renders a 'Mappa' string above the tab bar and the .first locator hit that). Since the map's 3D engine (map3d/engine) is only paused by setMapRenderHold(true) inside the cinematic overlay and released on unmount (Cinematic.tsx:110-111), and no cinematic was active at the point of the tab tap, the map should render — but formal regression not captured this iteration.

ui_bugs.issue: On the very first play triggered right after landing on /cinematics (before the /api/worlds/{id}/me query has hydrated), player?.house?.crest and player?.alliance?.tag are still null, so the overlay renders with the fallback shield icon and no [DEMO] banner (cinematic-crest and cinematic-alliance-banner absent). On subsequent plays (once the query cache is warm), both render correctly (verified in the conquest and battle-replay flows — see screenshots iter15_pyramid_scene.jpg and iter15_battle_conquest.jpg with 'Casa Demo' + '[DEMO]' + crest visible). The house name 'Casa Demo' was also absent on that cold play. Fix: either await me.data before showing the play buttons (disable the Pressables while !player), or memoise the last-known crest/allianceTag into a ref so a cold cinematic still shows the identity that will hydrate a moment later.

issues: In the SwiftShader web preview, switching from one cinematic to another back-to-back can freeze the second overlay for tens of seconds while the new scene's shaders compile (a re-play of the CONQUEST scene right after DRAGON did not surface cinematic-skip within 40s in one attempt). CinematicGL.tsx correctly gates the show clock on the first pixel readback (line 48-51), so on-device this is invisible; on the web preview a user tapping 'Salta' during that freeze cannot dismiss the overlay because cinematic-skip is not mounted yet. Consider showing a lightweight 'Salta' fallback after ~2s of no first-frame so the user is never stuck (grace timeout in Cinematic.tsx line 107 currently uses 6s to start the clock — the Salta gate could be tied to the same grace).

action_items: MEDIUM: cinematics.tsx cold-play hydration — gate the Pressables (or memoise crest/allianceTag) so the first cinematic in a fresh session shows the player's crest + [DEMO] banner instead of the fallback shield.

OPTIONAL: also apply the memoised-identity fix to /march/new.tsx line 74 (same pattern) and /battle/[id].tsx line 87-88, in case a player deep-links straight into a battle screen while `player` is still loading.

OPTIONAL: mount cinematic-skip earlier (e.g. after the grace timeout in Cinematic.tsx line 107 fires OR after 2s of not-yet-started state) so a user can always dismiss a stalled 3D scene on slow devices.

INFO: real DEPARTURE trigger from /march/new was NOT exercised this iteration; the same CinematicProvider entrypoint is verified via the gallery and the battle-report replay button (both call cinematic.play with the identical `spec` shape), so functional coverage is high. If you want an end-to-end proof, iter14 already did this successfully.

INFO: 'Mappa' tab-bar regression after a cinematic could not be re-captured cleanly (the test hit a 'Mappa' label on the settlement screen instead of the tab-bar chip). map3d/engine's setMapRenderHold is correctly released in Cinematic.tsx unmount (line 110), so the map should render — worth an explicit re-check by main agent on device or via `[data-testid="tab-map"]`.
critical_code_review_comments: CinematicGL.tsx:39-55 — the show clock is started only after the first `gl.readPixels(0,0,1,1,…)` sync (line 48). Nice pattern: on-device this pushes ~200ms of shader-compile latency onto a black frame instead of eating into the 4/6/8s show. On the web preview (SwiftShader) it can freeze for several seconds, which is why cinematic-skip may not appear on time — expected, but see the action-items suggestion to mount skip on the grace timer too.

CinematicGL.tsx:27-58 — onContextCreate correctly disposes the previous rig before creating a new one (line 29-33), and the cleanup effect (line 61-71) cancels the RAF and disposes world/scene. No GL leaks across replays.

Cinematic.tsx:97 sceneSpec is memoised on `[spec, plan]`; plan is memoised on `[spec]`. Legendary detection (line 65) picks the first legendary unit key found in units — correct because a march can only carry one legendary at a time (Bible §41.2).

Cinematic.tsx:107 — a 6s grace timeout starts the show clock if `onReady` never fires; matches the review-request note (headless web GL can take 8-9s but on-device is <200ms). Suggest tying `setCanSkip(true)` to the same grace so the user is never stuck.
Cinematic.tsx:106 setMapRenderHold(true) on mount + cleanup on unmount (line 110) — good: the map3d engine yields the GPU to the cinematic and resumes when the overlay unmounts.

cinematics.tsx:44 — `player?.house?.crest ?? null, allianceTag: player?.alliance?.tag ?? null` — this is the source of the cold-start crest/banner gap. Adding `disabled={!player}` on the Pressables (or a spinner if !player) would eliminate the edge case.
cinematics.tsx entries array — 8 rows, all seconds correct (standard/falcon 4s; major/dragon/angel/demon 6s; conquest/pyramid 8s) matching cinematicPlan (Cinematic.tsx:68).

No deprecated Expo packages spotted in Cinematic.tsx, CinematicGL.tsx, cinematics.tsx, scene3d/scenes.ts, march/new.tsx or battle/[id].tsx (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch). Correct choice of expo-gl for the 3D host.

success_rate.frontend: 80% — 6/8 review-request flows verified (gallery, dragon variant with 3D scene + auto-dismiss, conquest scene rendering + skip, pyramid variant via battle replay, battle-report replay, no red screens/errors). 2 flows partially covered: real march-launch DEPARTURE not executed (functional coverage via gallery + battle replay), Mappa tab regression inconclusive due to selector artefact.

context_for_next_testing_agent: 3D cinematic testIDs verified in iter15: cinematic-overlay, cinematic-title, cinematic-crest, cinematic-alliance-banner, cinematic-composition, cinematic-skip; markers cinematic-departure / -conquest / -dragon / -angel / -demon / -falcon; gallery rows cinematic-play-{standard|falcon|major|dragon|angel|demon|conquest|pyramid}; battle screen buttons battle-cinematic-departure and battle-cinematic-conquest; screens cinematics-screen, cinematics-back-button, house-cinematics-button, settlement-house-button. IMPORTANT: cinematic Pressables trigger `cinematic.play(spec)` which mounts an in-app overlay — they do NOT navigate. Playwright's default post-click wait ('waiting for scheduled navigations to finish') will hang the test for 30s on these clicks; ALWAYS pass `no_wait_after=True` to `page.click` for any cinematic-play-* button (also for cinematic-skip). ALSO: on this SwiftShader web preview the first GL frame of each variant can freeze the page 1-9s while shaders compile; if you play two cinematics back-to-back the second one may take >40s to mount its skip button — either wait longer or dismiss the previous overlay AND wait ~2s before the next play. Use viewport 390x844. To reach the gallery from a fresh login: /worlds → world-enter-world_1 → tap 'Città' text on the bottom tab → settlement-house-button → house-cinematics-button. The demo player's alliance tag is [DEMO] and their house is 'Casa Demo' — expect these to appear in the cinematic HUD (they DO on warm plays; on cold-first play the fallback shield icon is shown, see ui_bugs).
rca_of_issue: One functional gap found: cold-start crest/banner (cinematics.tsx:44 uses `player?.house?.crest ?? null` and `player?.alliance?.tag ?? null`). If the user reaches the gallery before the /api/worlds/{id}/me query has resolved, `player` is undefined and the cinematic overlay shows the fallback shield icon with no [DEMO] pill and no 'Casa Demo' name. The GL scene itself and every other testID render correctly. Fix: either (a) disable the Pressables while `!player`, or (b) cache the last-known crest/allianceTag in a ref so a cold play is not identity-less, or (c) fetch player synchronously before Screen renders. Not a regression per se; also present latent in march/new.tsx:74 and battle/[id].tsx:87-88 but never observed because those screens themselves depend on hydrated context to work at all.
